title: Distillation / Iterative Refinement
observed_structure: a procedure repeats with measurable reduction of noise
each pass preserves one volatile essence while removing one obstruction
later repetitions become more precise rather than merely more intense
dramatic_operations: compress a scene to its operative core
cinematic_affordances: repeated scene geometry with fewer elements
ambient layers removed one by one
camera movement narrows toward one decisive relation
cultural_scope: European alchemical source; use as iterative reduction and preservation
transferable_structure: successive passes remove interference while concentrating one causally important quality
non_transferable_surface: retorts, vapor coils, occult glassware, or explained purification symbolism
